title.zh-TW: 支援檔案覆蓋系統提示並放寬 -p 順序
title.en: Support file-based system prompt overrides and flexible -p order

body.zh-TW:
想每次叫 Grok 照固定格式整理筆記，現在不用在指令裡重打長長一段規則。加上 `--system-prompt-file <path>` 參數，就能直接從指定的檔案載入並覆蓋系統提示（給 AI 的預先指示）。

使用 `-p` 帶出提問時，現在把其他選項參數寫在 `-p` 後面也行，後面接上的多個單字還會自動串成同一句提示詞。如果只單獨打 `-p`，它則會改從標準輸入（從管線或上一步接進來的資料）讀取內容。⟦就像以前寄包裹得現場重填寄件人規定、順序還不能對調，現在直接夾上印好的規則單就行，補充說明放前放後都能一起收進單子裡。⟧
body.en:
If you want Grok to organize notes in a fixed format every time, you no longer need to retype a long block of rules in your command. Add the `--system-prompt-file <path>` flag to load and override the system prompt (advance instructions for the AI) directly from a specified file.

When using `-p` to pass a prompt, you can now place other option flags after `-p`, and any extra words following it are automatically joined into a single prompt. If you type `-p` by itself, it reads from stdin (data passed in from a pipeline or previous step) instead. ⟦Previously, shipping a package meant rewriting the sender's rules on the spot in a strict order, whereas now you can just clip on a printed rule sheet and any extra notes placed before or after still get included on the form.⟧

items.original:
`--system-prompt-file <path>` lets you load a system prompt override from a file
`-p` now accepts flags after it and joins any extra words into the prompt; bare `-p` reads from stdin

title.zh-TW: 多開工作階段時可直接切換與分支對話
title.en: Switch and fork conversations directly across multiple open sessions

body.zh-TW:
手邊一次開了多個工作階段（開啟中的對話）處理不同事情，以前剛開好的空白對話常常切換不過去。按下 `Ctrl+[` 和 `Ctrl+]`，就能切進所有已開啟的工作階段，就算裡面還沒輸入任何內容也一樣。

如果想針對另一個 Grok 視窗正開著的工作階段按 `Ctrl+F` 或輸入 `/fork`，現在不再直接跳出回合失敗的錯誤。畫面會改顯示提示，詢問你是否要直接將它分支成新對話。⟦跟在書桌上擺好幾疊草稿一樣，以前空白紙張總被跳過、別桌正在看的資料也不能直接影印一份，現在每一疊都翻得到，想複製開新頁也不會被擋下。⟧
body.en:
When you have multiple sessions (active conversations) open at once for different tasks, newly opened blank ones used to be unreachable when switching. Pressing `Ctrl+[` and `Ctrl+]` now cycles through all open sessions, even if nothing has been typed in them yet.

If you press `Ctrl+F` or type `/fork` on a session that another Grok window currently has open, it no longer immediately throws a turn-failed error. Instead, a notice appears asking whether you want to fork it into a new conversation. ⟦Picture having several stacks of drafts on a desk: blank sheets used to be skipped and papers someone else was reading at another table could not be photocopied, whereas now you can flip to every stack and copy one onto a fresh page without getting blocked.⟧

items.original:
`Ctrl+F` or `/fork` now offers to fork a session that another Grok window has open, shown as a notice instead of a turn-failed error
`Ctrl+[` and `Ctrl+]` now switch between all open sessions, including fresh ones that have no typed content yet

title.zh-TW: 歡迎畫面可直接用方向鍵操作選單
title.en: Navigate the welcome screen menu directly with arrow keys

body.zh-TW: 剛打開工具準備從起始畫面挑功能，游標還停在輸入提示列就能直接按方向鍵移動。不需要先把游標切離輸入位置，一進歡迎畫面就能照著選單項目往下選。
body.en: When you first open the tool to pick an option from the start screen, you can press the arrow keys to move while the cursor is still on the input prompt. You do not need to move the cursor away from the input area first—as soon as the welcome screen appears, you can step down through the menu items.

items.original: Arrow keys on the welcome screen now move through the menu directly from the prompt

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式 JSON 出錯仍保留已印回覆
title.en: Preserve printed reply text on headless JSON errors

body.zh-TW: 自動化腳本常會啟用無頭模式（沒有終端機視窗或視覺介面的執行模式），並指定以 JSON 這種結構化格式輸出結果。要是執行到一半發生錯誤，失敗前已經印出來的回覆文字現在會保留下來。⟦把這過程想成印表機出紙，以前印到一半卡紙就把整份抽走重來，現在已經印出來的那幾行都會留在出紙盤上。⟧
body.en: Automation scripts often enable headless mode (running without a terminal window or visual interface) and specify output in a structured format like JSON. If an error occurs midway through execution, any reply text already printed before the failure is now preserved. ⟦Think of this like a printer feeding paper: jamming halfway through used to mean pulling the whole sheet out and starting over, whereas now the lines already printed stay in the output tray.⟧

items.original: Headless JSON errors now preserve any reply text already printed before failure

title.zh-TW: Hooks 清單收合列直接顯示逾時與指令
title.en: Show timeouts and commands on collapsed Hooks list rows

body.zh-TW: 想快速確認目前設定了哪些自動化規則，打開 Hooks 清單（掛鉤，特定事件發生時會觸發的小程式）就能瀏覽。現在各列維持收合狀態時，畫面上還是會直接顯示每個掛鉤的逾時時間和執行指令，不必逐一展開來看。⟦翻找資料夾時，以前得把每個袋子拆開才看得到裡面裝什麼跟放多久，現在袋口標籤直接寫清楚了。⟧
body.en: To quickly check which automation rules are currently configured, you can open the Hooks list (small programs triggered by specific events) to browse them. Even while rows remain collapsed, the screen now directly displays each hook's timeout and command so you do not have to expand them one by one. ⟦When digging through folders, you used to have to open every pouch to see what was inside and how long it could stay, whereas now the label on the flap spells it out clearly.⟧

items.original: Hooks list now shows the timeout and command of each hook on collapsed rows

title.zh-TW: Konsole 滑鼠滾輪改為每格捲動三行
title.en: Scroll three lines per mouse wheel notch in Konsole

body.zh-TW: 在 Konsole（一款終端機軟體）裡檢視長篇輸出並上下捲動畫面，現在滑鼠滾輪的節奏不會跟這個終端機本身不一樣了。只要滾輪轉動一格，畫面就會固定捲動三行，跟 Konsole 自己的行為完全一致。
body.en: When viewing long output and scrolling up or down in Konsole (a terminal emulator), the mouse wheel pace no longer differs from the terminal itself. Each notch of the wheel now scrolls a fixed three lines, matching Konsole's own behavior.

items.original: Mouse wheel in Konsole now scrolls three lines per notch, as in Konsole itself

title.zh-TW: 直接呼叫 MCP 工具過長結果會截斷並存檔
title.en: Truncate and save oversized direct MCP tool results to files

body.zh-TW: 直接呼叫 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具取回資料，有時會遇到回傳結果特別長的狀況。現在只要結果過長，就會先截斷並將這些結果寫進檔案裡。⟦店員印出超長明細時，以前整張紙條會拖得老長，現在小紙條只保留截斷後的前段，長內容另外裝進資料袋裡。⟧
body.en: When calling an MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) tool directly to fetch data, the returned result can sometimes be extra long. Now, whenever a result is too long, it gets truncated first and written out to a file. ⟦Imagine a clerk printing an extra-long receipt: the paper strip used to trail on forever, whereas now the slip only keeps the truncated front section and the full contents go into a separate folder.⟧

items.original: Direct MCP tool calls now truncate oversized results and spill them to files
